{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices consistently exceed forecasts by 1-3 points",
    "Lag effect: model fails to fully capture price momentum, especially during upward trends",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0) leads to larger forecast-price gaps as model under-predicts bullish moves",
    "Sentiment negative ( <0) has minimal error as model and prices move similarly downward",
    "Price mean reversion is missing from forecasts - model maintains levels too far from recent extremes",
    "When sentiment flips from positive to negative, model over-forecasts by ~1-2 points",
    "Price volatility expansion is not captured - forecasts are too smooth relative to true volatility"
] }
